lines.t: Toot that trumpet, let the spirit ring This ain't no ordinary train
It's the trumpet's old train Steppin' on the platform, hearts open wide
With it rollin' through the rhythm where love can't hide
Voices liftin' higher, truth in every tone The word is our conductor, takin' us home
Ride that trumpet so strength, hey, hallelujah sound
Joy in the music, blessings all around
Every detail message, every note divine
We're groovin' for the kingdom, leavin' doubt behind
Shinin' shoes and smilin', movin' in time
Every soul's a singer, every word a sign
Life from the heavens flowin' through the groove
Spirits in the rhythm, watch as people move
The volumes of truth is alive
From city streets to the holy plains
We're riding free on our trumpet soul train
Goin' to his name on the Trumpets' old train
